description: Distinguishes a manifest publisher mismatch from damaged keys or machine trust.
prompt: 0x8007000B for Oxalis Ledger. Our other apps work with this cert; its subject is CN=Oxalis Software Ltd, but this manifest has Publisher=CN=Oxalis Development. Which name do I use?

paraphrases.novice: Signing Oxalis Ledger fails with 0x8007000B. Our certificate works elsewhere, and I noticed the company names in these two files are different. Which name should I change?
paraphrases.terse: 0x8007000B signing Oxalis msix. Certificate subject and manifest Publisher differ.
